2 عنّاهُ , (S, Mgh, Msb, K,) inf. n. تَعْنِيَةٌ, (S, Msb,) He caused him to suffer difficulty, distress, or trouble; (S, Mgh, * K;) or fatigue, or weariness; (S, K;) as also ↓ تعنّاهُ , (S,) or as also ↓ اعناهُ : (K:) or he imposed upon him that which was difficult, distressing, or troublesome, to him: (Msb:) or he annoyed, molested, harmed, or hurt, him; and caused him to grieve or mourn, or to be sorrowful or sad or unhappy. (Har p. 120.) ―
-b2- [See also 2 in art. عنو.] ＝
-A2- عنّى الكِتَابَ, mentioned in the K in this art.: see Q. Q. 1 in art. عنو.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
